description:
Use when a manager, dispatcher, or safety director needs to have a coaching conversation with a
driver — about a safety event (harsh brake, hard turn, distraction), an HOS violation, a customer
complaint, a missed delivery, repeated minor incidents, or to deliver positive recognition.
Covers conversation structure, language, documentation, and escalation.
